main_text.l: plectatur. Nimirum, ut postea explicat, Ubi a fundamentis suis convell-

unico Deo, puraque doctrina tentatur, ad extremum illud remedium descendere

main_text.l: necesse, ne tale venenum longius serpat &c. Et pag. 821. Nobis quam

l.i: servanda sit tum manfuetudo, nulla dubitatio est, quin judicio praire debeat
placida & religiosa doctrina cognitio. Sed hoc minimè obstaculo est, quin
Magistratus officium sit, gladio & poenis coercere, qui quum ipsi sint apostatae
à recta fide, alios ad defectionem sollicitant, & in Deum contumeliosi mise-
ras animas illaqueant suis fallaciis, pacem conturbant Ecclesiae, & pietatis

main_text.l: consensum scindunt & lacerant. Bullingerus Decad. 2. Serm. 8. In perso-

l.i: nis, inquit, magna est diversitas. Sunt enim antesignani, & duces pervica-
ces in erroribus, qui audaces, sunt, hypocritae, & loquaces, & ideireo ad se-
ducendum appositissimi, ipsi quidem citra emendationem in propriam ruentes
perniciem, & alios secum pertrahentes. Et hi modis omnibus sunt coercen-
di, veluti Ecclesiae pestes, ne contagio ipsorum ceu cancer serpat latius. Sunt
deinde seducti quidam ac dementati ab aliis, qui errant, sed non malitiâ,
neque pertinaciter. Hos non oportet damnare protinus, sed orare Dominum,
& errantes spiritu lenitatis & manfuetudinis erudire, donec redeant ad
meliorem mentem. Et postea, Jam & in supplicijs & poenis insigne est diseri-
men. Pertinaciter errantes, & alios secum in errorem abducere, & in erro-
ribus retinere contendentes, blasphemi, & perturbatores, imò subversores
Ecclesiarum, jure caedi possunt; ideo tamen capitis supplicio non protinus effi-
ciendus omnis qui errat. Et qui minis & increpationibus curari possunt, non
debent acerbioribus elui & puniri: modus in re quaelibet est optimus &c.

page.notes: Marginal "QVÆST. XXXIV." at left, first line, is a question marker and is recorded as a note with no letter. The first word "gitimè" is a fragment at the page start, as printed. Italic boundaries of the Bullinger and Calvin quotations are inferred from the scan and may be imperfect. The asterisk-like mark in "fatemur di*ndam" is a doubtful reading (probably "dicendam" or similar), left for review. Some words in the faded lines are uncertain; no [?] was placed on individual words because the reading of the scan was deemed generally secure, but the italic passages and the word "deviatus" should be checked against the original.
